property_summary: For every role and account, renouncing a role (even one the caller does not hold) from the caller's own address must succeed as a harmless no-op; the mutant inverts the confirmation check so a caller renouncing itself reverts with AccessControlBadConfirmation.
change_summary: Invert the confirmation check to `==` so that renouncing reverts when the caller IS the confirmed account, and succeeds otherwise.
